import React, { useContext, useState } from 'react' import { Link } from 'react-router-dom' import { apivalue } from '../../Data/AllData' function SectionProp() { const data = useContext(apivalue) const [search, setsearch] = useState("all") const getValue = (value) => { setsearch(value) } return (
{data?.map((item) => { const show = search === "all" || item.category === search; return show ? (
{item.category}
{item.price}

{item.title}

  • Brand: {item.brand}
  • stock: {item.stock}
  • id: {item.id}
Details
) : null; })}
) } export default SectionProp
